name: quick-quote-engine
description: Fincart Quick Quote Engine — multi-carrier quote aggregation with streaming results

scripts.dev: npm run dev:api & npm run dev:web
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:starter && npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/starter/tsconfig.json --noEmit
